_note: The memory ablation, which is the one paired comparison runnable before any method exists: the method library is empty until runs with repair rounds have been distilled, so A-vs-B on a flat method library has no B yet. What this measures instead is whether the capsule helps at all — the same briefs with the project's memory records active and with them parked. EvoMemBench's finding is the hypothesis worth testing: memory helps hard tasks and can hurt easy ones, so the two arms are expected to differ by brief rather than uniformly.
